entities.name: PMID:25091578
observations: In vitro study in human metastatic melanoma cell lines A375 and 518a2; simvastatin induced p38/COX-2-dependent 15d-PGJ2 synthesis and medium accumulation.
Medium 15d-PGJ2 concentrations were sufficient to activate caspase-8 and mitochondrial apoptosis; inhibition of lipocalin-type PGD synthase abolished simvastatin-induced apoptosis.
15d-PGJ2/FABP5 signaling was implicated; FABP5 knockdown abolished PPAR-γ activation and amplified apoptosis. Primary melanocytes were not affected.

entities.name: Simvastatin
observations: In human melanoma cell models, simvastatin stress induced 15d-PGJ2 synthesis and an apoptotic response; inhibition of lipocalin-type PGD synthase abolished the apoptotic effect (PMID:25091578).

entities.name: 15d-PGJ2
observations: Simvastatin-stressed metastatic melanoma cells accumulated 15d-PGJ2 in culture medium at levels reported sufficient to trigger caspase-8 and mitochondrial apoptosis; blocking its synthesis abolished the simvastatin apoptotic effect (PMID:25091578).

entities.name: Human metastatic melanoma cells
observations: In vitro A375 and 518a2 cell models showed simvastatin-induced autocrine 15d-PGJ2-linked apoptotic signaling (PMID:25091578).
